same_slot_accuracy: mean_b min_i(ADE_bi + 0.5 FDE_bi), first physical slot tie; not minADE and minFDE from different slots

dpp.quality: locked StageA qkin only; no map defaults

existing.trainable: new DSF only; all old F16+h3 weights and bool buffers frozen
existing.loss: accuracy - lambda * EC/20 for accuracy_dpp; accuracy for accuracy_only
existing.old_pure_DPP: read-only historical reference, not rerun; changed EC scaling means not a sole-factor add-accuracy comparison to old study

cvae.context: same frozen cached 64D observed context; includes old h3.context observation projection, not its trajectory generator
cvae.DSF: 64->128ReLU->320 plus fixed per-seed 20x16 Gaussian bank; zero-last offsets
cvae.loss: accuracy + Gaussian_posterior_reconstruction + beta_KL*KL(q||p) - lambda*EC/20; joint posterior/prior/decoder/DSF updates from scratch; only DPP enabled/disabled differs between arms
cvae.inference: past-only cached context -> conditional prior + DSF -> K20; no future/posterior

coefficients: fixed engineering defaults BEFORE any new result, not claimed optimal or literature-derived; no sweeps/held tuning
held_lock: all12 new finals/source/stat contracts SHA sealed before any new dev GT/group evaluation

statistics.sampling: shared whole dev target-track draw then paired model-seed draw; window-weighted then seed mean
statistics.invalid: no refill; >5% invalid or <20 change tracks -> UNDERPOWERED

old_gates: coveragefirst, same-slot ADE<=.2 AND FDE<=.4; old-success lost<=1%; protected overall/stable/transition ADE/FDE<=1.01native; all seed/split/group FIVE pooled-motion<=1.01native; change ADE/FDE each5% and coverage5pp/CI disclosed; no epsilon/floor/selector; no automatic baseline promotion
resource: warning-first v3. E from measured own preflight + explicit payload/allocator inventory; pending actual measurement; no fixed6GiB or hard1.3 kill
scientific_limits: shared one observed encoder pretrained on existing data; three NEW CVAE generator seeds vs only three DSF optimizer seeds for existing family; architectures/capacity/reachable sets differ; cross-family is not pure architecture causality or whole-model independence
